Standard: Bleed air ducting and components operate within the design operating temperatures and pressures without material or functional degradation. Bleed air ducting and component surface temperatures do not present a SOF hazard for nearby structure, wiring, flammable fluids and materials, and equipment. Installation prevents impingement and chafing of ducting under all air vehicle flight conditions. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Inspect drawings to verify that standoff distances and clamping prevent chafing and impingement of ducting and components. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct analysis to determine worst-case bleed air pressure and temperature combinations under normal operating and failure conditions.
  (2) Conduct thermal analysis to verify that bleed air component surface temperatures do not result in any SOF hazard to nearby structure, wiring, flammable fluids, or equipment. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct component-level testing to verify that bleed air ducting and components meet the structural integrity requirements IAW JSSG-2009, Appendix D, Proof Pressure paragraph.
    (2) Lab test: Conduct component-level testing to verify that bleed air ducting and components meet the structural integrity requirements IAW JSSG-2009, Appendix D, Burst Pressure paragraph.
